mapper.select: SELECT SCHEDULE_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, START_DT, END_DT, SCHEDULE_TYPE, REGISTER, REGIST_DT FROM SCHEDULE WHERE SCHEDULE_ID = #{scheduleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SCHEDULE ( SCHEDULE_ID, TITLE, CONTENT, START_DT, END_DT, SCHEDULE_TYPE, REGISTER, REGIST_DT ) VALUES ( #{scheduleId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{startDt}, #{endDt}, #{scheduleType}, #{register}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE SCHEDULE SET TITLE = #{title}, CONTENT = #{content}, START_DT = #{startDt}, END_DT = #{endDt}, SCHEDULE_TYPE = #{scheduleType}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPDUSR = #{updusr} WHERE SCHEDULE_ID = #{scheduleId}
mapper.select: SELECT HOLIDAY_DE, HOLIDAY_NM FROM HOLIDAY WHERE HOLIDAY_DE LIKE #{yyyymm} || '%' ORDER BY HOLIDAY_DE
mapper.update: MERGE INTO HOLIDAY target USING (VALUES (#{holidayDe}, #{holidayNm})) source(holiday_de, holiday_nm) ON target.HOLIDAY_DE = source.holiday_de WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.HOLIDAY_NM = source.holiday_nm WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (HOLIDAY_DE, HOLIDAY_NM) VALUES (source.holiday_de, source.holiday_nm)
